title_sq: Prane Pallatit Te Brigadave, Shitet Vile Me Arkitekture Moderne Me Pishine!
description_sq: Prane Pallatit te Brigadave, Shitet Vile me arkitekture Moderne me Pishine! Vila ka nje siperfaqe totale ndertimi 560m2 eshte e organizuar ne 3 kate ku kati 1 perbehet nga nje hapesire open space qe sherben si kuzhine ambient ndenje dhe tualeti. Kati 2 eshte organizuar nga korridori hyres, salloni, kuzhina , tualeti dhe dy dhoma gjumi. Ne katin e 3 jane te vendosura 3 dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe ballkoni. Vendodhja stratigjike e viles me akses direkt ne unazen e Madhe dhe afersia me Parkun e Liqenit e ben kete vile ideale per investim dhe banim. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet prona eshte ideale per nje jetese te qete.
title_en: Near the Palace of the Brigades, Villa with Modern Architecture with Swimming Pool for Sale!
description_en: Near the Palace of the Brigades, Villa with modern architecture for sale with swimming pool! The villa has a total construction area of ​​560m2 and is organized in 3 floors where the 1st floor consists of an open space that serves as a kitchen, living room and toilet. The 2nd floor is organized by the entrance corridor, living room, kitchen, toilet and two bedrooms. On the 3rd floor there are 3 bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. The strategic location of the villa with direct access to the Great Ring and the proximity to the Lake Park makes this villa ideal for investment and residence. The area in which the property is located is ideal for a quiet life.
